docs.text: Now THIS is what deep freeze over a Great Lake looks like. Lake Ontario is too big/deep to freeze over, though many protected sections do and have, such as parts of Toronto harbour where people are skating these days. Dawn glow with vapour ghosts - gorgeous.
Ice on Lake Ontario on New Year’s Day
Lake Ontario was gearing up today & we can see the start of ice shelves 😃 Woohoo!

Very cold tonite on the Market Square rink next to Lake Ontario in Kingston, Ontario, Canada.🇨🇦 My parka keeps my body warm & my KN95 wards off frost bite. Fire pits next to the rink give skaters & spectators the chance to warm up in the frigid nite air.

A wintery Monday night on the shores of majestic Lake Ontario. Dressed in our parkas, the biting wind doesn’t bother us as we skate on the rink in historic Market Square in ‘The Limestone City’ (Kingston, Ontario, Canada).🇨🇦❤️⛸️⛸️
Gadwalls taking off, swan, ice breaking up. Spring on a bay of Lake Ontario 🪶

Yours truly standing rink side in historic Market Square, with Kingston City Hall in the background. (It is very cold with the wind chill coming off of Lake Ontario.) The ‘Spirit of Winter’ festival runs through the weekend & ends on Family Day (Feb. 17). 🇨🇦🪶❄️
& the cold snap continues! This is what it looks like from the ferry leaving the Toronto Island ⛴️🧊🥶❄️ So much of Lake Ontario is frozen!
i’ve been kind of morbidly enamoured with the idea of walking out into the icy waters of lake ontario since i read “detransition, baby” tbh
The rink in Kingston’s historic Market Square was not crowded this evening. The wind off of Lake Ontario was cold as light snow flurries fell. I live for skating in January, my favourite month!🇨🇦❄️⛸️
All frozen. A mighty view of Lake Ontario in the ominous midwinter from .bsky.social

Lovely Sunday winter run: High Park, Lake Ontario, Humber River trail. Joyful at -16C / 3F.
Magnificent: people of all ages and abilities having fun. Specially nice many children + new Canadians of all ages learning to skate. Physical activity outdoors = best medicine for mental & physical health.
Ngl, this is the first time I got to see part of Lake Ontario frozen in person 😅, looks really cool tho 👀

I don’t know that one but it looks great!
My local path is fantastic. If it’s is cold enough, there’s nothing better. It’s not great when the ice warms up and sticks to your blades… but cold days, sharp skates? Bliss. The wind off the lake (a little beyond the path) hurts but it’s worth it.

Abbotts frozen custard. I know it's winter but it's worth it. Also if you want to see Lake Ontario, the Charlotte (it's pronounced shar-LOT) at Ontario Beach Park is a good view. And the Susan B. Anthony house.
Lake Ontario is frozen, offering a beautiful sight.
Watching these brave souls taking the cold plunge into Lake Ontario 🥶
The 19yo’s car was stuck on the Ice Planet of UB, so we drove her to work. By then it was +3 but Lake Ontario keeps sending us little wisp-waves of southeasterly drifting snow.
